developer_reply: Hi there, Simon! Thanks for using Habitica! There are Language options under Settings. However, not all translations are complete, as our translations are done by volunteers. If you'd like to help, you can learn more here: https://habitica.fandom.com/wiki/Guidance_for_Linguists

text: Since December 2022, moderation in public areas has been close to non-existing. Staff are generally treating volunteer contributors poorly (and rudely), and has recently started removing posts that are criticizing recent changes and additions. Furthermore, both the apps and the website has been buggy for years. The platforms rely heavily on volunteer work, which is shady considering they are a for-profit company. As a task-management platform, it's okay, but there are other much better.
